performance_case.causal_mechanism: If large complete-UTC-day BTC shocks create a persistent risk state rather than only a directional price response, the exact next-day RV24 relative to its pre-shock trailing-20-day median should remain elevated across untouched forward UP and DOWN episodes. This audit freezes only the point-in-time evidence and decision machinery needed to test that mechanism without changing the existing directional evaluator.
performance_case.claim_boundary: A positive result proves only that one sibling, research-only forward volatility-persistence diagnostic can be specified from the existing COMPLETE_UTC_DAY source, active rollover lineage, sole V10 heartbeat, Server Canonical writer and outbox with exact D-21 through D+1 closure, formula, identity, breadth, concentration and terminal rules. It proves no forward episode, prediction, significance, causality, strategy mapping, risk budget, fees, slippage, PnL, drawdown, candidate, OOS, deployment activation or Trading value, and authorizes only one later bounded implementation task.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. Only after untouched forward retention and a separately preregistered equal-capital strategy experiment could volatility-state information be tested as a sizing or participation control; until then drawdown, underwater duration and missed-convexity effects remain MISSING_PROOF.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Freezing one sibling diagnostic now prevents future outcome-aware formula or gate selection and reuses the existing daily evidence path without another source or clock. The cost is at least 23 same-leaf complete days before the first possible episode, at least 12 qualifying shocks before a positive terminal review, and deliberate refusal to convert a descriptive prior into premature strategy work.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: This specification audit has zero immediate fee-adjusted PnL effect. Its value is shortening the time from future complete-day shocks to an honest retained-or-closed volatility-state mechanism conclusion while preserving all economic testing for a later separately frozen experiment.
